Note::url_decode¶

Back to Note API Reference

Signature¶

Note Note::url_decode() const

Decode Percent-Escapes In Every Cell¶

url_decode() is the inverse of url_encode: it replaces every %XX escape in each cell with the byte it names, and also turns a + into a space. Use it to recover a value taken from a URL path segment, a query field, or a form body.

The + asymmetry¶

url_encode() never produces + — it writes a space as %20. But url_decode() still treats + as a space, because form-encoded data (application/x-www-form-urlencoded) uses + for spaces and it is common to have to decode both. So the pair is not perfectly symmetric on inputs that contain a literal +: url_decode() of "a+b" is "a b". If you need a literal + preserved, it must arrive as %2B.

Non-escape characters pass through untouched, and a malformed escape (a % not followed by two hex digits) is left as-is rather than raising. Bytes from %XX runs are reassembled directly, so a percent-encoded UTF-8 sequence decodes back to the original characters. The operation is shape-preserving, cell-independent, and returns a fresh Note.

Example 1: Percent-Escapes¶

std::cout << pluss::note::print(
    pluss::make_note({"a%20b%26c%3Dd", "caf%C3%A9"}).url_decode())
    << "\n";

Output¶

Note(shape=[2], dim=1, numel=2, encoding=utf8)
["a b&c=d", "café"]

%20 → space, %26 → &, %3D → =, and %C3%A9 reassembles the two bytes of é.

Example 2: + Decodes To A Space¶

const pluss::Note n = pluss::make_note({"a+b+c"}).url_decode();
std::cout << n << "\n";

Output¶

Note(shape=[1], dim=1, numel=1, encoding=utf8)
["a b c"]

Example 3: Round Trip From url_encode¶

pluss::note::print(std::cout,
                   pluss::make_note({"a b/c?d", "café"}).url_encode().url_decode())
    << "\n";

Output¶

Note(shape=[2], dim=1, numel=2, encoding=utf8)
["a b/c?d", "café"]

Example 4: Clean Text Passes Through¶

std::cout << pluss::note::print(
    pluss::make_note({"already-clean_text.~"}).url_decode())
    << "\n";

Output¶

Note(shape=[1], dim=1, numel=1, encoding=utf8)
["already-clean_text.~"]
